newsitem.title: USA: Oakhurst to dispose units, take write-off.
newsitem.headline: Oakhurst to dispose units, take write-off.

text.p: Oakhurst Co Inc said Friday it has sold its Puma Products subsidiary and also plans to dispose of its H&H Distributors subsidiary.
Oakhurst said it has reflected a write-off in its February 1997 year-end results of about $3.5 million for both plans.
It said Puma, which has incurred operating losses during the past two years, has been sold to its chairman and former owner, Anthony Puma.

Terms included cancellation of $600,000 in debt due from Oakhurst, repayment by Mr. Puma of $400,000 in short-term debt owed by Puma Products and cancellation of future earnout obligations of Oakhurst to Mr. Puma, carried at a book value of $600,000, Oakhurst said.
The pact also provides for Mr. Puma to make a payment to Oakhurst in the event he re-sells the business, under certain circumstances.

Additionally, Oakhurst said it will also dispose of H&H Distributors Inc through either a sale to its president and former owner, Harold Garfinkel, or some other form of disposition. It said H&H also has incurred operating losses.
